town_description: Peren is the headquarters town of Peren district in southern Nagaland, in the Zeliangrong Naga (Zeme, Liangmai, Rongmei) heartland near Ntangki National Park. A small administrative hill town on the Dimapur-Kohima corridor; Indian visitors from outside Nagaland need an Inner Line Permit (ILP).
